tables.name: compliance.licenses
tables.fact_owner: Versioned regulatory license for exactly one legal or operating subject

checks.name: licenses_exact_subject_ck
checks.expression: num_nonnulls(organization_subject_id,branch_id,membership_id,employee_id,party_id) = 1 AND (organization_subject_id IS NULL OR organization_subject_id = org_id)

checks.name: licenses_type_ck
checks.expression: license_type_code IN ('drug_wholesale_form_20b','drug_wholesale_form_21b','drug_schedule_x_wholesale_form_20g','state_pharmacist_registration')

checks.name: licenses_type_subject_ck
checks.expression: (license_type_code IN ('drug_wholesale_form_20b','drug_wholesale_form_21b','drug_schedule_x_wholesale_form_20g') AND (organization_subject_id IS NOT NULL OR branch_id IS NOT NULL OR party_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (license_type_code = 'state_pharmacist_registration' AND (membership_id IS NOT NULL OR employee_id IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: licenses_dates_ck
checks.expression: valid_from >= issued_on AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until >= valid_from) AND (next_verification_due_on IS NULL OR next_verification_due_on >= valid_from)

checks.name: licenses_perpetual_review_ck
checks.expression: license_type_code NOT IN ('drug_wholesale_form_20b','drug_wholesale_form_21b','drug_schedule_x_wholesale_form_20g') OR (valid_until IS NULL AND next_verification_due_on IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: licenses_verified_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('active','suspended','expired') OR (verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: licenses_status_ck
checks.expression: status IN ('pending','active','suspended','expired','revoked')

checks.name: licenses_row_version_ck
checks.expression: row_version > 0

indexes.name: licenses_subject_branch_idx
indexes.where: branch_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('active','suspended')

cross_row_invariants.name: licenses_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: The database CHECK is the executable v1 vocabulary; adding a license type requires a reviewed schema migration rather than an unverified string or absent lookup. Prohibit overlapping active licenses for the same subject/type/authority. Drug wholesale Forms 20B, 21B and 20G are perpetual unless suspended/cancelled, so require a next verification date instead of fabricating expiry; evidence and subject are immutable after activation.

tables.name: compliance.recalls
tables.fact_owner: Regulatory product recall decision and execution lifecycle

checks.name: recalls_class_ck
checks.expression: recall_class IN ('class_i','class_ii','class_iii','market_withdrawal')

checks.name: recalls_scope_ck
checks.expression: scope IN ('batch','product','market')

checks.name: recalls_dates_ck
checks.expression: response_due_on IS NULL OR response_due_on >= initiated_on

checks.name: recalls_close_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'closed' OR (closed_on IS NOT NULL AND closed_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL AND closure_summary IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: recalls_status_ck
checks.expression: status IN ('initiated','in_progress','closed','cancelled')

checks.name: recalls_row_version_ck
checks.expression: row_version > 0

cross_row_invariants.name: recalls_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: A recall cannot close until every recall_batch is terminal and reconciled; cancellation is prohibited after any quarantine/recovery/destruction quantity is recorded.

tables.name: compliance.recall_batches
tables.fact_owner: M:N affected-batch scope and recovered quantity evidence for a recall

checks.name: recall_batches_quantities_ck
checks.expression: affected_quantity > 0 AND quarantined_quantity >= 0 AND recovered_quantity >= 0 AND destroyed_quantity >= 0 AND released_quantity >= 0 AND recovered_quantity + destroyed_quantity + released_quantity <= affected_quantity AND quarantined_quantity <= affected_quantity

checks.name: recall_batches_action_ck
checks.expression: last_action_at IS NULL OR (first_action_at IS NOT NULL AND last_action_at >= first_action_at)

checks.name: recall_batches_status_ck
checks.expression: status IN ('identified','quarantined','recovered','destroyed','released')

checks.name: recall_batches_row_version_ck
checks.expression: row_version > 0

cross_row_invariants.name: recall_batches_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Under batch and recall locks, cap affected/quarantined quantities by ledger-derived stock exposure; recovered/destroyed/released totals derive from posted inventory movements and cannot be manually inflated.

tables.name: compliance.temperature_readings
tables.fact_owner: Immutable measured temperature at one inventory location and optional batch

checks.name: temperature_readings_range_ck
checks.expression: maximum_allowed_celsius > minimum_allowed_celsius AND is_excursion = (temperature_celsius < minimum_allowed_celsius OR temperature_celsius > maximum_allowed_celsius)

checks.name: temperature_readings_humidity_ck
checks.expression: humidity_percent IS NULL OR humidity_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100

checks.name: temperature_readings_payload_ck
checks.expression: (payload_bytes IS NULL AND payload_media_type IS NULL AND payload_sha256 IS NULL) OR (payload_bytes IS NOT NULL AND payload_media_type IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(payload_sha256) = 32)

checks.name: temperature_readings_provider_ck
checks.expression: provider_event_id IS NULL OR provider_name IS NOT NULL

cross_row_invariants.name: temperature_readings_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Ingestion must select the exact active location storage rule covering measured_at and, when batch_id is present, the exact active product storage rule; persist both selected rule ids and their intersected permitted range, verify the provider envelope hash, atomically block affected released stock when is_excursion is true, and block UPDATE/DELETE. Corrections append superseding evidence rather than rewriting this fact.

tables.name: compliance.controlled_substance_entries
tables.fact_owner: Immutable statutory controlled-substance register entry tied to stock movement

checks.name: controlled_substance_entries_type_ck
checks.expression: entry_type IN ('receipt','dispatch','return_in','return_out','transfer_in','transfer_out','adjustment','destruction')

checks.name: controlled_substance_entries_direction_ck
checks.expression: direction IN ('in','out')

checks.name: controlled_substance_entries_quantity_ck
checks.expression: quantity > 0

checks.name: controlled_substance_entries_authority_ck
checks.expression: (authority_document_number IS NULL AND authority_document_date IS NULL) OR (authority_document_number IS NOT NULL AND authority_document_date IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: controlled_substance_entries_counterparty_license_ck
checks.expression: (counterparty_license_id IS NULL AND counterparty_license_number IS NULL) OR (counterparty_license_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(counterparty_license_number)<>'')

cross_row_invariants.name: controlled_substance_entries_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Require batch to be controlled, quantity/direction to equal the immutable stock-ledger entry, and any counterparty to hold a valid applicable license on entry_date; block UPDATE/DELETE.

tables.name: compliance.destructions
tables.fact_owner: Approved destruction evidence linked one-to-one to a posted inventory document

checks.name: destructions_approval_ck
checks.expression: status NOT IN ('approved','posted') OR (approved_at IS NOT NULL AND approved_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: destructions_posted_ck
checks.expression: status <> 'posted' OR (posted_at IS NOT NULL AND posted_by_membership_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: destructions_separation_ck
checks.expression: approved_by_membership_id IS NULL OR approved_by_membership_id <> created_by_membership_id

checks.name: destructions_status_ck
checks.expression: status IN ('draft','submitted','approved','posted','cancelled')

checks.name: destructions_row_version_ck
checks.expression: row_version > 0

cross_row_invariants.name: destructions_cross_row_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Approval requires a distinct authorized actor and verified certificate. Posting requires the linked inventory document be type destruction, posted, and line quantities/batches match approval; this table never mutates stock and is frozen after posting.

tables.name: compliance.controlled_movement_rule_versions
tables.fact_owner: One effective reviewed statutory evidence rule for a Drugs Rules schedule, NDPS scope and stock-movement kind

cross_row_invariants.name: controlled_movement_rule_versions_release_authority
cross_row_invariants.rule: Only the isolated regulatory importer inserts the exact canonical row set of a verified controlled_movement_rules release. Applicability, required organization/counterparty license types, prescription and authority-document requirements are immutable; active effective periods for one rule dimension cannot overlap and release supersession retires the prior set atomically.

checks.name: controlled_movement_rule_versions_schedule_ck
checks.expression: drug_schedule IN ('ANY','NONE','G','H','H1','X')

checks.name: controlled_movement_rule_versions_ndps_ck
checks.expression: ndps_scope IN ('any','regulated','not_regulated')

checks.name: controlled_movement_rule_versions_entry_ck
checks.expression: entry_type IN ('receipt','dispatch','return_in','return_out','transfer_in','transfer_out','adjustment','destruction')

checks.name: controlled_movement_rule_versions_counterparty_ck
checks.expression: (counterparty_required AND btrim(COALESCE(counterparty_license_type_code,''))<>'') OR (NOT counterparty_required AND counterparty_license_type_code IS NULL)

checks.name: controlled_movement_rule_versions_dates_ck
checks.expression: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>=effective_from

checks.name: controlled_movement_rule_versions_status_ck
checks.expression: status IN ('active','retired')

tables.name: compliance.storage_rule_versions
tables.fact_owner: Reviewed effective product or location environmental storage range with immutable evidence

cross_row_invariants.name: storage_rule_versions_effective_guard
cross_row_invariants.rule: Exactly one typed product or location subject owns each rule. Verified retained evidence and a distinct authorized reviewer are required; active effective periods cannot overlap for the same subject, and referenced rules are immutable and retired only by a superseding reviewed version.

checks.name: storage_rule_versions_subject_ck
checks.expression: num_nonnulls(product_id,location_id)=1 AND ((subject_kind='product' AND product_id IS NOT NULL) OR (subject_kind='location' AND location_id IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: storage_rule_versions_range_ck
checks.expression: maximum_celsius>minimum_celsius AND ((minimum_humidity_percent IS NULL AND maximum_humidity_percent IS NULL) OR (minimum_humidity_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND maximum_humidity_percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND maximum_humidity_percent>minimum_humidity_percent))

checks.name: storage_rule_versions_dates_ck
checks.expression: effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to>=effective_from

checks.name: storage_rule_versions_status_ck
checks.expression: status IN ('active','retired')

indexes.name: storage_rule_versions_product_idx
indexes.where: product_id IS NOT NULL AND status='active'

indexes.name: storage_rule_versions_location_idx
indexes.where: location_id IS NOT NULL AND status='active'
